errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a category with the given ID or name does not exist.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product with the given ID does not exist.

errors.name: InvalidSkuError
errors.description: Raised when the SKU is not unique or already exists.

errors.name: InvalidStockThresholdError
errors.description: Raised when the reorder threshold is not a positive integer.

errors.name: InvalidPriceError
errors.description: Raised when the price is not a positive integer.

errors.name: InvalidStockQuantityError
errors.description: Raised when the stock quantity is not a non-negative integer.

errors.name: MalformedCategoryUpdateError
errors.description: Raised when the category update data is invalid (e.g., missing required fields).

errors.name: MalformedProductUpdateError
errors.description: Raised when the product update data is invalid (e.g., missing required fields).

errors.name: InvalidLowActiveFlagError
errors.description: Raised when the low_active flag is not a boolean.
